description: Image Description: The image shows a black laptop placed on a wooden desk. The laptop is open and displaying a screen with a file explorer window, showing a list of files or folders. The keyboard includes a red pointing stick in the center. The laptop has several stickers near the bottom left corner, suggesting it is an older model. The desk is cluttered with papers, and there is a packet of snacks on the left side. In the background, there is a door and a carpeted floor.
